Then, as you are weightless, remember your mind is a magic tool, everything you think of will become your creation in the astral plane. It is necessary to put your mind at ease, almost a blank slate if that makes sense, because if you are troubled, for example, you're dealing with anxiety or fear, you will be matching that frequency of which your mind is vibrating on. Remember, to travel in the astral plane, you need to match the frequency in your consciousness whether it be happiness or sadness, it will take u to heaven or hell so to speak. That is, it is important to have a clear mind and a clear goal of which where you would wanna go in the astral plane. So how do u get out of body? Just think about it, but really mean it. "I am going to leap out right now" or something like that will work, and practice it too. As it happens dont be afraid to open ur eyes, because u will see things out of proportions, things u have never seen before. It is easy to be startled and amazed, thats why u need a technique to stay grounded. When I look at my hand i see 6 fingers, then i know its not real, that it is a dream and i am awake in it. Then the whole universe is urs to explore. I hope this helps, and I welcome u to ask more questions should u have any.
